## The pipeline

```
tracker.api / create → tracker.scaffold → client drops into Shared/ → tracker.filer → tracker.scanner → tracker.reminder (Saturdays) → a person sends the draft
```

## Modules

### core

- **`tracker/__init__.py`** — Package docstring listing every component, and the re-exports of the manifest and scaffold APIs.
  - imports: `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`
- **`tracker/api.py`** — The JSON command layer the desktop app talks to: state, scaffold, sort, scan, create, rollover, templates, list, priors, reset. Also holds FORM_TEMPLATES (the per-form request checklists) and the demo sample-file builder.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.api`
  - imports: `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/rollover.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`
  - used by: `api_entry.py`, `tracker/rollover.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_runner.py`
  - note: Every command prints one JSON object and returns an exit code — errors are JSON too, never a traceback. This is the only module the Electron app knows about.
- **`tracker/content_check.py`** — Tier 3: extract text (pdfplumber / openpyxl / plain text, optional OCR) and test it against the row's keyword and date rules. Caches verdicts.
  - imports: `tracker/manifest.py`
  - used by: `tracker/router.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_content_check.py`
  - note: The cache stores pass/fail only. Extracted client text is never persisted.
- **`tracker/filer.py`** — Sorts the client's drop folder: moves each original into Shared/PBC/ untouched, copies a renamed working file into Prepared/... or 00 - Needs Review, and appends every move to _index.xlsx.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.filer`
  - imports: `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/router.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`, `tracker/validators.py`
  - used by: `tracker/api.py`, `tracker/rollover.py`, `tracker/runner.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_filer.py`, `tests/test_rollover.py`
  - writes: `artifact:Prepared/`, `artifact:_index.xlsx`
  - reads: `artifact:Shared/`, `artifact:_manifest.xlsx`
  - note: Content-hash de-duplication makes re-runs no-ops. Originals are moved byte for byte under their own names and never altered.
- **`tracker/manifest.py`** — The _manifest.xlsx schema and every read/write of it. Owns RequestItem, Status, Override, load_manifest(), write_statuses() (lock-retry, then a pending-JSON sidecar merged on the next write) and create_template().
  - used by: `demo/demo_manifest.py`, `tracker/__init__.py`, `tracker/api.py`, `tracker/content_check.py`, `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/reminder.py`, `tracker/rollover.py`, `tracker/router.py`, `tracker/runner.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`, `tracker/validators.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_content_check.py`, `tests/test_filer.py`, `tests/test_manifest.py`, `tests/test_reminder.py`, `tests/test_rollover.py`, `tests/test_router.py`, `tests/test_runner.py`, `tests/test_scaffold.py`, `tests/test_scanner.py`, `tests/test_validators.py`
  - writes: `artifact:_manifest.pending.json`, `artifact:_manifest.xlsx`
  - note: Every other module goes through this to touch the manifest. create_template() writes ONLY the accountant's columns — scanner state is written separately by write_statuses(), which is why seeding a test fixture takes both calls.
- **`tracker/registry.py`** — Loads and validates engagements.yaml — the one file listing every engagement the scheduled run touches.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.registry`
  - used by: `tracker/runner.py`, `tracker/scheduling.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_registry.py`, `tests/test_runner.py`
  - reads: `artifact:engagements.yaml`
  - note: Fails loudly on an unknown key, a bad date or a duplicated path, because a typo that silently skipped a client would surface at a filing deadline. A missing folder is NOT rejected here; that is the runner's call, per engagement.
- **`tracker/reminder.py`** — Drafts the client chase email from a scanned manifest. Draft only — there is no SMTP anywhere in this module.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.reminder`
  - imports: `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`
  - used by: `tracker/runner.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_reminder.py`, `tests/test_runner.py`
  - writes: `artifact:reminder-draft.txt`
  - reads: `artifact:Prepared/`, `artifact:_manifest.xlsx`
  - note: Validation notes are translated into plain client instructions, never quoted. Rows we have not read yet, and rows with no request folder, are held back for a person instead of being asked for. Each draft carries a fingerprint of its own text so an edited draft is never overwritten.
- **`tracker/rollover.py`** — Builds a returning client's next-year request list from their prior engagement. Prior-year data always wins; the template may only fill blanks.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.rollover`
  - imports: `tracker/api.py`, `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`
  - used by: `tracker/api.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_rollover.py`
  - reads: `artifact:_manifest.xlsx`
  - note: Years shift as a set so relative periods stay right. Counts learn from what arrived and never shrink. Waived carries forward; Accepted does not. NOTE: rollover and api import each other - api imports rollover at module scope, rollover imports api only inside its __main__ block. That cycle is deliberate; do not "fix" it by hoisting the import.
- **`tracker/router.py`** — Decides which single manifest row a dropped file belongs to. Evidence order: required keywords, then any-keywords/period, then filename (text-less scans only).
  - imports: `tracker/content_check.py`, `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/validators.py`
  - used by: `tracker/filer.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_router.py`
  - note: Extension alone never routes. A document matching one row's required keywords but failing its other rules is contested and blocks its own filing — misfiling a tax document is worse than not filing it.
- **`tracker/runner.py`** — The unattended pass: for every engagement in the registry, file -> scan -> (on Saturdays) draft. This is the whole scheduled task.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.runner`
  - imports: `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/registry.py`, `tracker/reminder.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_runner.py`
  - reads: `artifact:engagements.yaml`
  - note: Owns the Saturday rule in is_draft_day(); the scheduler does not know about it. One engagement's failure never stops the others, and the run exits non-zero so the scheduler shows red.
- **`tracker/scaffold.py`** — Turns a manifest into folders: Shared/ (the client's one drop folder) + Shared/PBC/, and Prepared/{Identifier} - {Document}/ plus 00 - Needs Review. Writes the client's _README.txt.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.scaffold`
  - imports: `tracker/manifest.py`
  - used by: `tracker/__init__.py`, `tracker/api.py`, `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/reminder.py`, `tracker/rollover.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`, `tracker/validators.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_filer.py`, `tests/test_reminder.py`, `tests/test_rollover.py`, `tests/test_runner.py`, `tests/test_scaffold.py`, `tests/test_scanner.py`
  - writes: `artifact:Prepared/`, `artifact:Shared/`
  - reads: `artifact:_manifest.xlsx`
  - note: Also the home of the path constants every other module imports: MANIFEST_FILENAME, SHARED_DIR_NAME, PBC_DIR_NAME, PREPARED_DIR_NAME, REVIEW_DIR_NAME.
- **`tracker/scanner.py`** — The orchestrator: walks Prepared/, runs the three validation tiers, resolves each row's status (override- and revert-aware), and writes the result back into the manifest.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.scanner`
  - imports: `tracker/content_check.py`, `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`, `tracker/validators.py`
  - used by: `tracker/api.py`, `tracker/runner.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_scanner.py`
  - writes: `artifact:_manifest.pending.json`, `artifact:_manifest.xlsx`
  - reads: `artifact:Prepared/`
  - note: Holds a stale-aware per-engagement run lock, so two scheduled runs cannot overlap. Never touches Shared/ at all.
- **`tracker/scheduling.py`** — Generates the Windows Task Scheduler XML or n8n workflow that runs tracker.runner unattended.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.scheduling`
  - imports: `tracker/registry.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_scheduling.py`
  - note: One daily task is enough because the runner decides the drafting day. Recognizes Windows drive-letter paths as absolute even when generating from Linux.
- **`tracker/validators.py`** — Tiers 1-2: does the file exist, is the extension allowed, is it big enough, is the PDF readable. Pure read-only functions plus passive cloud-placeholder detection for OneDrive and Google Drive.
  - CLI: `python -m tracker.validators`
  - imports: `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`
  - used by: `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/router.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`
  - tested by: `tests/test_validators.py`
  - note: Never downloads a cloud-only placeholder — a stub must never be filed as if it were the document.

### desktop-app

- **`app/main.js`** — Electron main process. Spawns the Python API (`python -m tracker.api`, or the frozen tracker-api.exe in the portable build) and relays its JSON to the renderer over IPC.
  - note: This is the cross-language boundary: everything the UI can do is a tracker.api command.
- **`app/package.json`**
- **`app/preload.js`** — Context bridge exposing exactly two calls to the renderer: tracker.call(args, payload) and tracker.open(path). Nothing else crosses.
- **`app/renderer/app.js`** — The desktop UI: the form-type wizard, the request list and the scan results. Talks only to window.tracker from the preload bridge.
- **`app/renderer/index.html`** — Desktop app shell markup.
- **`app/renderer/logo.svg`**
- **`app/renderer/style.css`** — Desktop app styling.

### demo

- **`demo/demo_manifest.py`** — Hands-on walkthrough of the manifest layer, including the Excel-lock retry and sidecar behaviour you can watch live by holding the file open in Excel.
  - CLI: `python -m demo.demo_manifest`
  - imports: `tracker/manifest.py`
- **`demo/standalone/tax-document-tracker.html`** — A single self-contained HTML file that ports the scanner's rules to the browser. Opens offline with nothing installed, for emailing to staff or demoing on a prospect's laptop.
  - note: A faithful port, not a shim: same statuses and same validation notes as the Python scanner. It has to be kept in step with tracker/scanner.py and tracker/validators.py by hand.

## Artifacts (files the system reads and writes at runtime)

- **`artifact:Prepared/`** — The firm-side working set: renamed copies sorted per request, plus 00 - Needs Review for anything that could not be identified. The client never sees this.
  - written by: `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`
  - read by: `tracker/reminder.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`
- **`artifact:Shared/`** — The client's one drop folder — the only thing they see and the only thing they touch. Their originals end up in Shared/PBC/, still visible to them, untouched.
  - written by: `tracker/scaffold.py`
  - read by: `tracker/filer.py`
- **`artifact:_index.xlsx`** — Every original the client sent: where it came from, where it went, and what it was renamed to. The audit trail.
  - written by: `tracker/filer.py`
- **`artifact:_manifest.pending.json`** — Sidecar holding status updates that could not be written because Excel had the manifest locked. Merged into the next successful write.
  - written by: `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`
- **`artifact:_manifest.xlsx`** — The engagement's request list and its live status. Sits OUTSIDE the client's shared scope — the accountant's file, not theirs.
  - written by: `tracker/manifest.py`, `tracker/scanner.py`
  - read by: `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/reminder.py`, `tracker/rollover.py`, `tracker/scaffold.py`
- **`artifact:engagements.yaml`** — The registry: every engagement the scheduled run should process. Gitignored — it names real clients and carries their share links.
  - read by: `tracker/registry.py`, `tracker/runner.py`
- **`artifact:reminder-draft.txt`** — The drafted chase email, waiting for a person to read, edit and send. Carries a fingerprint so the weekly job can tell whether it has been edited.
  - written by: `tracker/reminder.py`

## Rules that cut across the code

- **rule:no-AI-on-client-documents** — No generative AI ever reads a client financial document. Every routing and status decision comes from deterministic rules in the manifest.
  - enforced in: `tracker/content_check.py`, `tracker/validators.py`
- **rule:nothing-is-ever-sent** — The system drafts client emails and stops. There is no SMTP, no mail client and no network call in the reminder or scheduling path; a person always sends.
  - enforced in: `tracker/reminder.py`, `tracker/runner.py`, `tracker/scheduling.py`
- **rule:nothing-is-guessed** — A document is filed only when exactly one request accepts it. Ambiguous, contested and unrecognized files go to 00 - Needs Review for a person.
  - enforced in: `tracker/filer.py`, `tracker/router.py`
- **rule:originals-are-never-altered** — Originals are moved byte for byte under their own names into Shared/PBC/ and never renamed in place, edited or deleted. All work happens on copies.
  - enforced in: `tracker/filer.py`
